reconstructed_theorem_text:
Objects: Put E=Euclidean R^I, S={x:||x||=1}, and V_j(x)=e_j-x_j*x, so [V_j(x)]_i=delta_ij-x_j*x_i. Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T).

Domains: I finite with decidable equality; Omega measurable; filtration on R_+; finite measure mu; T>=0; sphere-valued X:R_+ x Omega->S; temperature a:R_+->R; i,j in I. Output is a ProgressiveL2Integrand(filtration,mu,T).

Quantifiers: A definition for every I,instances,Omega,measurable structure,filtration,mu,finite-measure instance,T,X,proof of joint measurability,proof of strong progressiveness,a,proof of continuity,i,j.

Assumptions: Input proof requirements: X jointly measurable and strongly progressive; a continuous. T need not be positive and a need not be nonnegative.

Conclusion: The definition returns the record whose process(t,omega)=sqrt(2*a(t))*(delta_ij-X_j(t,omega)*X_i(t,omega)); its progressive field proves strong progressiveness of this process, and its memLp field proves membership of (omega,t)->process(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T). Internally c(t,w)=sqrt(2*a(t))*[e_j-w_j*w]_i and process(t,omega)=c(t,X(t,omega)); the other let/have terms construct the proof fields.

Scopes: The body specifies a pointwise process on all R_+ x Omega; the integrability certificate concerns [0,T]. This is a bundled definition, not a theorem asserting existence of a process with otherwise unspecified values. Real.sqrt is total and zero on negative inputs.

Constant dependencies: The process formula depends on X,a,i,j. The record type and integrability proof also depend on filtration,mu,T and supplied structures/proofs. No selectable numerical constant or additional hypothesis occurs.
